newsitem.title: USA: Costa Rica buys 46,000 T long-grain rice - trade.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rica buys 46,000 T long-grain rice - trade.

text.p: Costa Rica bought Tuesday 46,000 tonnes U.S. long-grain paddy rice, U.S. exporters said.
The deal was in two parcels. One lot was for 23,000 tonnes at $288.34 a tonne, CIF landed, for February arrival, and the other lot was for 23,000 tonnes at sellers option.

"They also bought 23,000 tonnes of U.S. long-grain rice at $291.41 a tonne CIF for April arrival or at sellers option, Argentinian long-grain paddy at $286.41 a tonne, CIF, for April arrival," a U.S. exporter said.
"Costa Rica formally has confirmed the sale on Tuesday," he added.
